description: This is a Java source file defining a custom runtime exception CommandHandlerNotFoundException, which is used in the context of command handling within the Apache Fineract project. The class provides a constructor that generates an error message when a command handler cannot be found for a given command.

classes.name: CommandHandlerNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that no command handler was found for a specific command.

methods.name: CommandHandlerNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a Command object and constructs an error message indicating the absence of a matching handler.
